title: Driveable training worlds
summary: A reproducible training checkpoint is a coherent world containing model state, optimizer state and training-session state; restoring only weights is insufficient when the omitted state changes continuation.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: Model, optimizer and session are separate semantic objects.
State-of-the-Nation checkpoints restore all registered training participants together.
Optimizer learning rate, momentum, velocity and step are historical state.
Training status/epoch/objective/metrics are historical state, not logging decoration.
procedure: Construct MLTrainingRun with the model and optional optimizer.
Use the post-registration initialCheckpoint as the rewind origin.
Begin the session, drive model/optimizer/session, then checkpoint the coherent training world.
Rollback with a preserved future before changing data, hyperparameters or policy; roll-forward to compare/restore the old world.

provenance.claim: Driveable gradient optimizer, training session, training evidence and coordinated training run.
Regression proves iterative model + optimizer + session rollback and roll-forward.
